Definition: a burrower, i.e. probably a rat
BiblicalUsage: Chaphor is the burrower, the mole, and it appears once: in that day a man shall cast his idols of silver and gold to the moles and to the bats.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is deliberate: idols made to be worshipped end up in the dark with the creatures that never see the sun.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
